messages:
marie: Heads up — spike in 5xx from inference-proxy in us-east-1 started ~09:10UTC. CloudWatch shows NAT gateway ActiveConnections near the limit and a sharp rise in TCP TIME_WAIT. Anyone else seeing NAT port exhaustion?
infra-bot: ALERT: NAT_EPHEMERAL_PORTS high for nat-0a1b2c3d (us-east-1a). ConsumedTcpPorts=42900, AvailablePorts=1100.
juan: Yup, same pattern we saw last month with bulk model downloads — lots of short lived outbound TCP to external hosts. Can we confirm destination IPs/domains?
marie: Flows show heavy outbound to telemetry.redwood.ai:443 and api.external-eval.run:443 from the job-runner autoscale group. tcpdump shows repeated SYNs and many sockets in TIME_WAIT. Example: `ss -tan | grep TIME-WAIT | wc -l` -> 17234 on one host.
rachel: Short term mitigations: add another NAT gateway (per-AZ NATs), shift some subnets, and increase alerting. Medium/long term: VPC endpoints for S3/Telemetry or move telemetry behind a proxy so we reuse connections (connection pooling / keepalive).
sam: Agree. Per-AZ NAT gateways will reduce per-NAT connection load. I'll spin up a NAT in us-east-1b and reroute a test subnet to validate.
marie: Quick cost note — extra NAT GW ~ $36/month + data processing, but prevents prod errors. I spun up a NAT in us-east-1b and re-routed a subset; ActiveConnections dropped ~70% in 2 minutes and 5xxs subsided.
juan: Also consider app-level fixes: enable HTTP keepalives, connection pooling in our telemetry SDKs, and avoid creating new TCP for each event. OS tweaks like shrinking TIME_WAIT or expanding ephemeral port range are fragile — prefer pooling.
rachel: Action items: sam -> infra ticket to add 2 NATs per region + automation to detect port exhaustion. marie -> runbook + dashboard/alert thresholds. juan -> touch base with SDK teams about keepalive.
marie: CloudWatch filter we used: `SEARCH('{AWS/NATGateway,ResourceId} MetricName="ConsumedTcpPorts"', 'Sum', 300)` and alert when Sum > 30000 for 3 datapoints. Temp debugging commands: `ss -tan state time-wait | wc -l` and `aws cloudwatch get-metric-statistics --metric-name ConsumedTcpPorts --namespace AWS/NATGateway ...`
infra-bot: Incident ticket INFRA-6723 created by sam. Priority P2.
sam: I'll open a terraform PR adding per-AZ NATs + route table changes and run a canary in 2AZs. Pinging @ops-oncall for a deploy window.
ops-oncall: :thumbsup: I can take a 2hr window at 15:00UTC to watch metrics and rollback if needed.
marie: Thanks all — I'll post a short postmortem template once we confirm root cause and finalize SDK action items.
